record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my prayer<WH08605>, O LORD<WH03068>, give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> to my supplications<WH08469>: in thy faithfulness<WH0530> answer<WH06030><WTH8798> me, <FI>and<Fi> in thy righteousness<WH06666>.
And enter<WH0935><WTH8799> not into judgment<WH04941> with thy servant<WH05650>: for in thy sight<WH06440> shall no man living<WH02416> be justified<WH06663><WTH8799>.

For the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> hath persecuted<WH07291><WTH8804> my soul<WH05315>; he hath smitten<WH01792><WH00> my life<WH02416> down<WH01792><WTH8765> to the ground<WH0776>; he hath made me to dwell<WH03427><WTH8689> in darkness<WH04285>, as those that have been long<WH05769> dead<WH04191><WTH8801>.
Therefore is my spirit<WH07307> overwhelmed<WH05848><WTH8691> within me; my heart<WH03820> within<WH08432> me is desolate<WH08074><WTH8709>.
I remember<WH02142><WTH8804> the days<WH03117> of old<WH06924>; I meditate<WH01897><WTH8804> on all thy works<WH06467>; I muse<WH07878><WTH8787> on the work<WH04639> of thy hands<WH03027>.
I stretch forth<WH06566><WTH8765> my hands<WH03027> unto thee: my soul<WH05315> <FI>thirsteth<Fi> after thee, as a thirsty<WH05889> land<WH0776>. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>

Hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me speedily<WH04118>, O LORD<WH03068>: my spirit<WH07307> faileth<WH03615><WTH8804>: hide<WH05641><WTH8686> not thy face<WH06440> from me, lest I be like<WH04911><WTH8738> unto them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> into the pit<WH0953>. <RF>lest...: or, for I am become like, etc<Rf>

Cause me to hear<WH08085><WTH8685> thy lovingkindness<WH02617> in the morning<WH01242>; for in thee do I trust<WH0982><WTH8804>: cause me to know<WH03045><WTH8685> the way<WH01870> wherein<WH02098> I should walk<WH03212><WTH8799>; for I lift up<WH05375><WTH8804> my soul<WH05315> unto thee.
Deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me, O LORD<WH03068>, from mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>: I flee unto thee to hide<WH03680><WTH8765> me. <RF>flee...: Heb. hide me with thee<Rf>

Teach<WH03925><WTH8761> me to do<WH06213><WTH8800> thy will<WH07522>; for thou <FI>art<Fi> my God<WH0430>: thy spirit<WH07307> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896>; lead<WH05148><WTH8686> me into the land<WH0776> of uprightness<WH04334>.
Quicken<WH02421><WTH8762> me, O LORD<WH03068>, for thy name's<WH08034> sake: for thy righteousness<WH06666>' sake bring<WH03318><WTH8686> my soul<WH05315> out of trouble<WH06869>.

And of thy mercy<WH02617> cut off<WH06789><WTH8686> mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and destroy<WH06><WTH8689> all them that afflict<WH06887><WTH8802> my soul<WH05315>: for I <FI>am<Fi> thy servant<WH05650>.<CM>
